topic: GTA 6: Mister Mangrove the Skunk Ape (Bigfoot) is real, after the San Andreas Bigfoot myth and GTA 5's man-in-a-costume hunt
title: GTA 6 finally answered a 22-year-old rumor #shorts
lines: Is Bigfoot actually real in GTA 6?
Players caught a hairy giant eating a deer on a dirt road in Leonida.
Its name is Mister Mangrove, the Skunk Ape of the swamps.
A cryptid hunter named Kirk sends you after it, and in the end you choose who to shoot: the beast, or Kirk.
In 2004, San Andreas players searched the woods for Bigfoot, and Rockstar said he was never there.
GTA 5's Bigfoot hunt ended with a guy in a costume.
Twenty-two years later, the myth finally has real fur.
So next time you hear grunting in the swamp, ask yourself one thing.
description: For 22 years GTA fans chased a monster Rockstar swore wasn't there. GTA 6 just changed the answer. #gta6 #gtavi #bigfoot #gaming #shorts
